title: Guttmann-Flury et al. 2025 (SSVEP) — Dataset combining EEG, eye-tracking, and high-speed video for ocular activity analysis across BCI paradigms
description: A multimodal neuroimaging dataset combining EEG, eye-tracking, and high-speed video recordings from 31 healthy participants performing a 4-class steady-state visually evoked potential (SSVEP) brain-computer interface task. The dataset comprises 3,024 trials across 63 completed sessions with 64-channel EEG recordings (plus 1 EOG and 1 stim channel) at 1000 Hz sampling rate, designed to investigate ocular activity patterns and their relationship to BCI performance across multiple paradigms.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a 64-channel Neuroscan Quik-Cap with SynAmps2 amplifier at 1000 Hz sampling rate. The SSVEP paradigm consisted of 4-class frequency flickering stimuli (8, 10, 12, 15 Hz) presented via flickering LEDs, with 48 trials per session and up to 3 sessions per subject. Reference electrode was placed at the right mastoid (M1) with ground at forehead. Online high-pass filtering was applied with a 10-second time constant. Concurrent eye-tracking and high-speed video recordings were obtained to capture ocular activity during the task.
